title: Scherzer passes Perry for 9th all-time in strikeouts, August 30
dek: Max Scherzer struck out 10 batters on August 30, with his tenth strikeout (Cal Raleigh in the seventh inning) moving him to 3,535 career strikeouts and 9th all-time, surpassing Hall of Famer Gaylord Perry. The Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Seattle Mariners 7-0.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Scherzer recorded his 3,535th career strikeout on August 30, moving to 9th all-time and passing Gaylord Perry.
bottom_line: Scherzer now stands 9th all-time with 3,535 strikeouts. His standing on that list will grow or hold depending on his remaining appearances in 2026 and beyond.
body: Max Scherzer moved to 9th all-time in career strikeouts on August 30, surpassing Hall of Famer Gaylord Perry with 3,535 strikeouts. Scherzer reached the mark with his tenth strikeout of the game, Cal Raleigh in the seventh inning, per MLB.com.

The milestone came in a Toronto Blue Jays 7-0 victory over the Seattle Mariners. Scherzer's 10-strikeout performance in the win underscores the durability that has defined his career as an active pitcher competing in the stretch run of the season.
